spans.s: Mākandī^1, a region in the country of the Pāñcālas. § 209 (Drupadaśāsana): I, 138, 5512 (ºm atha Gaṅgāyās tīre janapadāyutāṃ so 'dhyāvasad dīnamanāḥ Kāmpilyañ ca purottamaṃ, sc. Drupada).
Mākandī^2, a city. § 556 (Sañjayayānap.): V, 31, 934 (among the five villages which the Pāṇḍavas wished to have from Duryodhana).--§ 562 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 72, 2595 (do.); 82, 2877 (do.).
Makaradhvaja^1 (“having a makara on his banner”) = Kāma: III, 16192.
Makaradhvaja^2 (do.) = Pradyumna: VII, 4263 (Kārshṇiḥ); XIII, 509 (ºsya mātā, i.e. Rukmiṇī).
